name: ballerinax/ai.memory.postgresql

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents a distinct error type for memory store errors.

typeDefs.name: DatabaseConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Database configuration for the PostgreSQL client.

fields.name: options
fields.description: Additional options for the PostgreSQL client

typeDefs.name: ShortTermMemoryStore
typeDefs.description: Initializes the PostgreSQL-backed short-term memory store.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the PostgreSQL-backed short-term memory store.

parameters.name: dbConnection
parameters.description: The PostgreSQL client or database configuration to connect to the database

parameters.name: maxMessagesPerKey
parameters.description: The maximum number of interactive messages to store per key

parameters.name: tableName
parameters.description:
The name of the database table to store chat messages (default: "chat_messages").
Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, and underscores.
Note that PostgreSQL folds unquoted identifiers to lower case.

parameters.name: checkpointTableName
parameters.description:
The name of the database table to store human-in-the-loop pause
checkpoints (default: "checkpoints"), created lazily on first use rather than
at initialization. Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits,
and underscores. Note that PostgreSQL folds unquoted identifiers to lower case.

return.description: An error if the initialization fails

functions.name: getChatSystemMessage
functions.description: Retrieves the system message, if it was provided, for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description:
A copy of the message if it was specified, nil if it was not, or an
`Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getChatInteractiveMessages
functions.description:
Retrieves all stored interactive chat messages (i.e., all chat messages except the system
message) for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: A copy of the messages, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getAll
functions.description: Retrieves all stored chat messages for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: A copy of the messages, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: put
functions.description: Adds one or more chat messages to the memory store for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The `ChatMessage` message or messages to store

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: removeChatSystemMessage
functions.description: Removes the system chat message, if specified, for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description:
nil on success or if there is no system chat message against the key,
or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: removeChatInteractiveMessages
functions.description:
Removes all stored interactive chat messages (i.e., all chat messages except the system
message) for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
Optional number of messages to remove, starting from the first interactive message in;
if not provided, removes all messages

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: removeAll
functions.description:
Removes all stored chat messages for a given key, including any pending human-in-the-loop
approval checkpoint for that key, so clearing a session is atomic and an abandoned pause
does not retain its whole history snapshot indefinitely.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: isFull
functions.description: Checks if the memory store is full for a given key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key associated with the memory

return.description: true if the memory store is full, false otherwise, or an `Error` error if the operation fails

functions.name: getCapacity
functions.description: Retrieves the maximum number of interactive messages that can be stored for each key.

return.description: The configured capacity of the message store per key

functions.name: putCheckpoint
functions.description: Stores (or replaces) the pending human-in-the-loop approval for its session.

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: getCheckpoint
functions.description: Returns the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session, if any.

return.description: The pending approval, nil if none is pending, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: removeCheckpoint
functions.description: Removes the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session, if any.

return.description: nil on success, or an `Error` if the operation fails

functions.name: takeCheckpoint
functions.description: Fetches and removes the pending human-in-the-loop approval for a session.

return.description: The claimed pending approval, nil if none was pending, or an `Error` if the operation fails
